notes.text: A registered app can move Vault funds only up to reservesOfApp[app] (collectFee) and via end-of-lock-settled deltas; a malicious registered app that books its own reserves still has to be paid first. The real risk of registerApp is a pool manager-class app that books OTHER users' deposits as its reserves.
